text:
Carmen Li: Heads-up from the marketplace intake team: Reviewer asks for a code-signing provenance bundle for our joint listing with IronGate SI. They want the public cert chain, a short explanation of the signing lifecycle, and a statement on whether keys are escrowed or retained. cc @Theo Grant @Maya Chen
Theo Grant: Understood. We should prefer a "no-escrow" position and offer a live verification window instead. Do we have a concise signing lifecycle doc we can share?
Maya Chen: We have a 1-page flow in the release runbook that shows: key generation in HSM -> CI signing step -> artifact registry -> signed image served. We can extract that and add the cert fingerprints. Also need to think about indemnity/limited liability language if marketplace insists on escrow.
legal-sig: Marketplace often uses escrow requests as a way to get in-country verification rights. We can sign a "no-escrow attestation" that keys reside in a non-exportable HSM and offer a scheduled remote attestation session. If they insist on escrow, propose a vetted escrow agent and a sealed-key workflow with tight legal protections. We'll draft both templates.
Carmen Li: Great. Reviewer also flagged they don't want raw PoCs or exploit attachments. Only high/critical finding summaries and remediation status. Keep TTLs short for presigned links. artifact-bot, can you prepare a manifest skeleton?
artifact-bot: Manifest skeleton created: items -> signing-lifecycle.pdf (14d), cert-chain.pem (30d), no-escrow-attestation.pdf (30d), remediation-summary.csv (14d). Manifest ID: ig-sign-2134567800.
Theo Grant: Ops, to generate the cert chain we need to pull current code-signing certs from VaultHSM and export the public certs. @SI-ops, can you coordinate with IronGate to confirm they accept the public chain only?
SI-ops: Confirmed. IronGate prefers the public chain + signed attestation. They will not request private key material. They may ask for a short live demo of the signing process.
Maya Chen: Timeline? Marketplace wants the bundle in 4 business days. Let's own it: Theo -> extract lifecycle PDF + cert fingerprints (due 24h). legal-sig -> draft no-escrow attestation + escrow-template (due 48h). SI-ops -> coordinate live attestation slot (if requested) (due 72h). artifact-bot -> generate presigned URLs when files are uploaded.
Theo Grant: I'll pull cert-chain.pem and produce signing-lifecycle.pdf. Note: fingerprint for current key: sha256: 1a:2b:3c:... (truncated). I'll include the full string in the PDF.
legal-sig: Drafting no-escrow attestation: brief text confirming keys generated and stored in FIPS-compatible HSM, private key non-exportable, signing operations logged and auditable. For escrow-template, will add agent identity, sealed-key procedures, and liability caps.
Carmen Li: Also include a short README describing redactions and why we excluded PII and PoCs. That helps speed review. artifact-bot, add README placeholder.
artifact-bot: README placeholder added to manifest ig-sign-2134567800. TTLs set as requested.
SI-ops: Coordinated with IronGate; they're available for a 30-min remote session next Thursday for live signing walkthrough. I'll block a provisional slot and share details after we upload artifacts.
Maya Chen: Good. One more nuance: marketplace asked whether code-signed artifacts are time-stamped. Confirmed?
Theo Grant: Yes, our signing process adds RFC3161 timestamp from an internal timestamper service (timestamper.redwood.internal). I'll include a short snippet in the lifecycle PDF and an example timestamp token (no sensitive data).
legal-sig: Minor legal note: if remote attestation reveals a gap that requires temporary delisting, we should have the marketplace accept a remediation window rather than immediate delist. I'll draft remediation window language in the escrow-template.
Carmen Li: Perfect. Final action recap:
- Theo Grant: lifecycle PDF + cert-chain.pem (due 24h)
- legal-sig: no-escrow attestation + escrow-template (due 48h)
- SI-ops: schedule live signing demo (provisional) and confirm partner acceptance of public chain (due 72h)
- artifact-bot: populate presigned links when files uploaded (automatic)

Carmen Li: Once manifest is ready we'll share with IronGate and the reviewer and note contact points for follow-up. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
